title: Align travel request APIs with employee travelers and expense report lifecycle
summary: Expense Agent APIs now align travel request and expense report workflows by adding employee filtering, creating expense reports during travel request approval, and supporting owner-scoped report recreation after draft deletion.
key_points: Employees API gains filterable isExpenseUser field to distinguish expense-enabled employees
Travel request approval automatically creates Expense Reports for the Requested For user and prevents duplicate creation
Travel requests expose employees as a read-only navigation property filtered by SystemId
Owner-scoped report recreation allowed after draft deletion if no existing posted history exists
Added indirect permissions and nonunique lookup keys to support these operations
quote: Aligns the Expense Agent travel request and expense report API flow used by the web client.
